legislature.scope_note: The source booklet explicitly compiles replies delivered in both Houses and is preserved as one edited two-House witness.

speech.event_ta: 1971-72 ஆம் ஆண்டுக்கான நிதிநிலை அறிக்கை மீதான விவாதங்களுக்கான இரு அவை பதிலுரைகளின் தொகுப்பு
speech.event_en: Edited compilation of replies to the debates on the 1971-72 financial statement in both Houses

unresolved_reading_locations.note: Narrow phrase after ஆகவே and before வட்டிக்காக remains visually ambiguous in the controlling scan. No outside wording was substituted.

Rajaji quotation from `நமது ஜனநாயகம்`: re-inspected directly from the controlling scan at high resolution during C.5-4; the short phrase remains insufficiently decisive for safe reconstruction. No outside edition was used.

transcription.gate_c_completion_note: Gate C first-pass Tamil transcription is complete for all 57 body pages, scans 4-60 / implied printed pp.3-59. Source-page markers 4-60 occur exactly once and in order. The first pass carried three unresolved readings at scans 11, 31 and 37; Gate C.5-3 resolved the scan-31 classroom anecdote directly from the controlling pixels, leaving two unresolved readings at scans 11 and 37.
transcription.gate_c5_note: C.5-1–4 audited scans 4-43 directly against rendered pixels. C.5-4 added 29 definite textual corrections across 24 source sites; cumulative Gate C.5 corrections are 80 across 64 sites. The existing scan-37 Rajaji-quotation uncertainty was re-inspected at high resolution and remains unresolved; scan 11 also remains unresolved. No outside witness or modernization was used.
